title_en: HBO Max Will Be Replacing House of the Dragon With a New DC Show Starting in August
body_en:
HBO Max has unveiled a solid lineup of new additions to the service in August. House of the Dragon is headed toward the conclusion of its third season, which will be followed by the next stop in James Gunn’s DC universe, Lanterns. Mother Mary leads the way for this month’s A24 streaming premieres, and the creators behind Robot Chicken will debut a new special for Adult Swim's 25th anniversary.
Read on for some of our top recommendations coming to the service or jump ahead to the full schedule of everything getting added to HBO Max each day .
This summer’s big HBO Original is reaching its end toward the beginning of the month. House of the Dragon Season 3 has been a real return to form for the Game of Thrones spin-off, consistently earning positive reviews . Things are certainly as complicated as ever, so one can only imagine what will play out for the Blacks and the Greens in the final two episodes. Probably some more devastating misunderstandings.
As always, HBO Max will be picking up older movies through new licenses. The bulk of these will be available starting on August 1, and one movie that’s definitely worth watching for any fans of the Dune saga is Sicario. Denis Villeneuve's crime thriller follows an FBI agent who gets roped into a government plot to take down a drug cartel leader. Be warned - It’s one of the most tense and terrifying movies I’ve ever seen.
After House of the Dragon reaches its end, a new series from James Gunn’s DC Studios will take its Sunday slot. A Green Lantern adaptation has been in the works through various iterations of the years, but the final version of the series is focused on the more experienced Hal Jordan and the new recruit John Stewart . Nathan Fillion is already confirmed to reprise his role from last year’s Superman, and I wouldn’t be surprised if we see connections to future DC projects like Man of Tomorrow.
HBO Max continues to be the streaming home for movies distributed by A24. While we’re still waiting on a streaming release date for breakout horror hit Backrooms , another A24 movie coming to the service we’d recommend is Mother Mary. Starring the incredible Anne Hathaway, IGN’s 8/10 review describes David Lowery’s latest “a pop star ghost story with an amazing look and a story that plays a background role to the interpretive dancing.”
Adult Swim is celebrating its 25th anniversary this year, and it’s no surprise that Robot Chicken creators Seth Green and Matthew Senreich were tapped for the festivities. This new special will celebrate over two decades of Adult Swim characters and shows through a murder mystery story in Robot Chicken’s classic stop motion style. It’ll be available to stream on HBO Max the day after premiering live on Adult Swim.
Things have gotten a bit funky for HBO Max. Well, they could. Warner Bros. put itself up for sale back in 2025 , and after a little bit of a battle with Netflix , Paramount came out as the buyer . More recently, however, 12 states launched an antitrust lawsuit against the potential acquisition, putting the whole thing at the very least on pause until the trial concludes.
What exactly any of that means for the Warner Bros. streaming service? Only time will tell.
In the meantime, HBO Max continues to offer three subscription plans starting at $10.99/month, and is also available in a discounted bundle with Disney+ and Hulu.
Blythe (she/her) is an Audience Development Coordinator at IGN who, when she isn't following streaming news, spends way too much time in character customization screens and tracking down collectibles.
